title: Counting Basis for Prior Use on a Refined Fuels Pre-Buy Request
content:
How far back the gallons taken on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts are counted, when a pre-buy request is being credited, depends on how often the truck has been to the site over the year and on whether the tank stands on the automatic keep-full schedule.

| Stops made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date | The tank's schedule | Months the account's prior use is counted over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | Standing on the automatic keep-full schedule | 24 |
| 3 or more | Not on the automatic keep-full schedule | 6 |
| Fewer than 3 | Either way | 12 |

**Where 3 or more stops were made on the account in the twelve months ending on the handling date and the tank stands on the automatic keep-full schedule**, the account's prior use is counted over the 24 months ending on the handling date.

**Where 3 or more stops were made in that window and the tank does not stand on the automatic keep-full schedule**, the account's prior use is counted over the 6 months ending on the handling date.

**Where fewer than 3 stops were made in that window**, the account's prior use is counted over the 12 months ending on the handling date.

The stop count is always taken over the twelve months ending on the handling date, whichever window it then selects. A tank on the automatic schedule with 2 stops in that year falls to the last line, not the first.

*Hypothetical.* An account with 5 stops in the year whose tank stands on the automatic keep-full schedule has its prior use counted over 24 months. The same account taken off the automatic schedule has it counted over 6 months. An account with 2 stops in the year has it counted over 12 months on either schedule.
